# UTM Builder

> Free UTM campaign URL builder that shows which GA4 default channel group a link will land in before you publish it. Presets for common channels, naming checks (lowercase, no spaces, consistent spelling), bulk mode for lists and CSV files, link history, and PNG/SVG QR codes. Runs entirely in the browser: no sign-up, no tracking, nothing is uploaded.

URL: https://lab.zalastack.com/utm-builder/

## Key facts

- GA4 says to always set utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign. Optional: utm_term, utm_content, utm_id, utm_source_platform.
- UTM values are case sensitive in GA4 reports. Use lowercase.
- GA4 assigns the default channel mostly from source and medium. A medium GA4 does not recognise (qr, print, partner, newsletter) lands in Unassigned.
- Paid pattern for mediums: ^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$ (cpc, cpm, paid-social, retargeting).

| Channel | Typical manual tags |
|---|---|
| Email | utm_medium=email |
| Organic Social | utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social |
| Paid Social | utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=paid-social |
| Paid Search | utm_source=bing&utm_medium=cpc |
| Display | utm_medium=display (or banner, cpm) |
| Referral | utm_medium=referral |
| Affiliates | utm_medium=affiliate |
| Audio | utm_medium=audio |
| SMS | utm_medium=sms |
| Unassigned | anything that matches no rule, e.g. utm_medium=print |

## Presets

Newsletter, LinkedIn organic, LinkedIn paid, Meta ads (with {{campaign.name}} style macros), Google Ads (ValueTrack macros), QR on print, Podcast, Partner / sponsor.
